obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must comply with the requirements laid down in Section 2 of Chapter III, taking into account their intended purpose, the state of the art in AI, and the risk management system referred to in Article 9.

Where a product contains a high-risk AI system subject to both this Regulation and Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I Section A, providers must ensure the product is fully compliant with all applicable requirements under that Union harmonisation legislation.

To ensure consistency, avoid duplication, and minimise additional burdens, providers may integrate necessary testing, reporting processes, information, and documentation for high-risk AI system compliance into existing documentation and procedures already required under Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I Section A.
exceptions: Integration is optional ('shall have a choice') and applies only where Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I Section A also applies to the product.
